system_description.narrative_title: Russia's coercive escalation and Western countermeasures
system_description.narrative_summary: Russia is consolidating control over Western assets, intensifying hybrid and kinetic attacks, and leveraging managed elections to legitimize its war, provoking new sanctions, tariff powers, and accelerated defence aid from the West. As an open system, this dynamic consists of cross-border flows of economic assets, energy, information, military force and legislation, with reinforcing feedbacks (asset seizures → sanctions/tariffs → retaliatory measures → increased military aid) and spillovers into corporate risk and domestic politics. The interaction is producing alignment shifts in Europe, pressure on global supply chains and energy markets, and faster militarisation and legislative responses from the US and EU.
system_description.scope: The geopolitical confrontation between Russia and Western/Ukraine-aligned actors during this news window: Russian asset seizures and justification, hybrid and kinetic attacks on Ukraine and infrastructure, Russia-managed domestic politics (elections), Western sanctions and tariff legislation, NATO/European defence responses, corporate exposure of multinationals operating in Russia.
system_description.super_system: The global international order—comprising international security architecture, global trade and finance, and multilateral governance (sanctions regimes, diplomatic norms).
adjacent_subsystems: European domestic politics and party realignments
Global energy markets and gas diplomacy
Multinational corporate risk and global supply chains
Arms industry, defence procurement and military logistics

variables.name: Coercive escalation intensity
variables.description: Measures the overall rate and intensity of coercive actions (kinetic, paramilitary and hybrid operations) directed across borders and critical infrastructure.

variables.name: Control over foreign assets
variables.description: Measures the degree to which domestic authorities exercise de facto control or takeover of foreign‑owned assets and operations within a jurisdiction.

variables.name: Sanctions and trade pressure
variables.description: Measures the aggregate severity and multilaterally coordinated intensity of punitive economic measures, tariffs and trade restrictions.

variables.name: Defense assistance flow
variables.description: Measures the rate and volume of military aid, equipment transfers and logistical support crossing borders to conflict‑affected actors.

variables.name: Alliance cohesion
variables.description: Measures the level of political and operational alignment among cooperating external actors on security, economic and diplomatic responses.

variables.name: Corporate exposure to contested markets
variables.description: Measures the scale and concentration of multinational commercial and operational exposure to contested or high‑risk jurisdictions.

variables.name: Information and narrative influence
variables.description: Measures the strength and reach of information operations, propaganda and competing narratives across media and social networks.

variables.name: Perceived electoral legitimacy
variables.description: Measures public and external perceptions of the credibility and acceptability of electoral processes and outcomes.

variables.name: Energy flow stability
variables.description: Measures the continuity, reliability and volatility of cross‑border energy supplies and related infrastructure operations.

variables.name: Supply chain resilience
variables.description: Measures the capacity of transnational supply chains to absorb, reroute or recover from disruptions originating in geopolitical conflict.

variables.name: Militarisation pace
variables.description: Measures the tempo of military build‑up, procurement and force posture changes across relevant actors and regions.

variables.name: Cyber and network attack rate
variables.description: Measures the frequency and intensity of cyber intrusions, disruptions and digital sabotage targeting state and civilian systems.

variables.name: Legislative and tariff authority intensity
variables.description: Measures the scope and assertiveness of enacted domestic legal powers, emergency statutes and tariff authorities used in economic coercion or defence.

variables.name: Cross‑border capital and asset flows
variables.description: Measures the volume and directionality of capital movements, investments and asset transfers between jurisdictions.

variables.name: Domestic political stability
variables.description: Measures the degree of social and institutional stability, protest pressure and regime resilience within affected societies.

variables.name: Defensive military capability
variables.description: Measures the operational readiness, integrated air/missile defence capacity and combat support capabilities available for defence.

catalysts.title: Expansion of Russian asset seizures
catalysts.description: Continuation or widening of Kremlin takeovers of Western corporate operations in Russia, following Nestlé and Auchan moves.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: Russia seizes Nestlé and Auchan operations; Putin targets Nestlé's Russian business.

catalysts.title: Use of new US tariff powers
catalysts.description: Administration exercise of recently signed tariff and sanctions authorities targeting Russian (and possibly third‑country) oil and trade flows.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: Trump gains tariff weapon; Trump signs Russia sanctions bill into law; bills target Russian oil importers.

catalysts.title: EU €3.3bn missile and drone disbursement
catalysts.description: Planned EU disbursement to Ukraine for missiles and drones, enabling procurement and deliveries to bolster Ukrainian defenses.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: EU to disburse €3.3 billion to Ukraine to procure missiles and drones.

catalysts.title: Delivery of $2.7bn US air‑defense systems
catalysts.description: Implementation and delivery process for US-approved $2.7bn air‑defense upgrades and systems for Ukraine.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: US clears way for $2.7 billion sale to Ukraine of air‑defense development upgrades.

catalysts.title: Poland joins anti‑ballistic cooperation
catalysts.description: Operational cooperation and integration between Poland and Ukraine on anti‑ballistic missile measures after Poland's formal joining.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: Poland joins anti‑ballistic missile coalition with Ukraine.

catalysts.title: Spike in Russian hybrid attacks
catalysts.description: Intensification of cyber, information and other hybrid operations attributed to Russia, targeting Western and Ukrainian systems.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: France says Russian hybrid attacks are intensifying; reports of online attacks on electoral systems.

catalysts.title: Post‑vote consolidation and crackdown
catalysts.description: Expected consolidation of Kremlin authority after parliamentary vote, including repression and narrative framing to justify actions.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: Russians vote in election; Explainer: How Putin may leverage predictable outcome of Russia's elections.

catalysts.title: Talks to restore Russian gas to Germany
catalysts.description: Planned contacts between a Putin envoy and Germany's AfD exploring ways to resume Russian gas flows to Germany.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: Putin envoy and far‑right AfD prepare talks to get Russian gas back for Germany.

catalysts.title: Follow‑up incidents and investigations after Kursk drone strike
catalysts.description: Further attacks, safety incidents or international probes stemming from the drone hit at Kursk nuclear plant, affecting operations and responses.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: Drone hit cooling tower on Thursday at Russian Kursk nuclear plant, IAEA says.

catalysts.title: Ramp‑up in Western defense production
catalysts.description: Acceleration of production and fast‑tracking of missiles, Patriot parts and new systems by Western defense firms.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: Lockheed gets Patriot parts from GM; GM to produce Patriot parts; Lockheed reveals new missile, fast tracks production.
